_note: show-view stage -> vizier scene. THE cue list: the follower resolves it, show-view only displays it (GET /show/status). Stages not listed fall through to `default`. Scene names must match the gallery manifest exactly (demos.html DEMOS + demos/syn/syn-manifest.js); GET /show/scenes lists them with an `available` flag. Confirmed cues: preshow -> TEST_CARD (no logo), opener -> NEBULA + logo. A row may name a `cues` file INSTEAD of driving one scene for its whole length; `scene`/`logo` stay beside it as the fallback used if that file fails to load.
_opener_note: `opener` is the 21-minute opening set, one continuous wav like the main set. Its cue doc holds a single scene cue (NEBULA + logo, i.e. exactly the old static row) plus one PALETTE cue per track: {type:'palette', at, fade, track, palette:{bias,amp,freq,phase,root,drift}} recolours the running NEBULA without changing scene, crossfading over `fade` seconds when the playhead walks over the cue. The 11 palettes in cues-pm-2026-opener.json are drafts — the operator refines them live from the console's CTRL tab, and the timeline editor owns the times.
_main_note: `main` is the DJ set: one continuous 78-minute wav, so it cannot be one scene. Its row names a cue file instead of a scene, and the follower's cue engine drives scene / logo / video inserts from the synced TRACK POSITION (demos/show/cues-pm-2026.json, snapped to the beat — see cues-snap-report.txt). A scene override (POST /show/scene) suspends the cue engine until it is released with {name: null}.
_black_note: BLACK is the blackout state (demos/viz-black.js): no scene, no GPU work, an actually black screen. Boot, `idle` and `done` sit there — those are the hours when the TV is on and the show is not. `preshow` still brings up TEST_CARD, which is the alignment card the operator wants while setting the room up. BLACK is a normal gallery scene, so it also shows up in GET /show/scenes and can be picked by hand from show-view's VISUALS grid.
